gaps.quote: the network's endpoint operator is the shear
gaps.note: Not a known concept, and the page neither explains nor links it. The reader cannot tell which operator of the network is meant, or why the endpoint operator is the shear.

gaps.quote: each combining $D$ with the earlier field $H$ in linear time
gaps.note: The page asserts linear cost for combining D with H on the tapes but gives no argument. The reader has not studied tape-level data-movement algorithms, so cannot check that moving data between the two fields costs only linear time.
The base case is stated with no argument. The page never describes the level-0 interchange of one-bit fields, so the reader cannot check that it costs constant time per unit volume.
The page never says m is an integer or at least 2. The binding on recursive-power-saving says only that m is a growth factor, so the reader cannot check m at least 2.

gaps.term: sign of tau in k = O(m^{k tau})
gaps.note: Bounding the sum by k gives O(m^{k tau}) only if tau is positive. The page fixes tau only by tau<1 and s/W<m^tau, so the sign of tau is not settled and the reader cannot check this step.
